footnotes.text: Acts 2:44–45. The Book of Mormon also contains an account of ancient Christians in the Americas holding “all things common among them” such that “there were not rich and poor” (4 Nephi 1:3).

An Ohio convert named Leman Copley, for example, had promised a large tract of Ohio farmland to the New York Saints; he changed his mind, possibly because he did not actually have legal rights to the land. See Historical Introduction to “Revelation, May 20, 1831 [D&C 51],”josephsmithpapers.org; see also “John Whitmer, History, 1831–circa 1847,” 17,josephsmithpapers.org.
